verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a standalone desktop app; codes are generated 'on iOS, Android and via browser extensions'. The browser extensions for 2FAS Auth and 2FAS Pass bring codes and vault items onto the computer, but only as phone-tethered companions: each request must be confirmed in the mobile app, and items are retrieved from the phone rather than stored on the desktop. Missing for 10: a native desktop app, standalone code generation and vault access on the computer without the phone, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the desktop experience.
